v1.40.4b (11 November 2024) |feed_title = Bug Fixes and QOL Improvements |feed_color = Beige |previous_update = [[v1.39.0|Hexscape Night III Update]] |next_update = [[v1.41.0|Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.40.0''' is the ninety-third update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 6th of November 2024. It added a few minor changes and fixes to the game. This update encompassed eight updates, the main v1.40.0 update (released 6 November 2024) and five minor updates, v1.40.0a (released 7 November 2024), v1.40.1 (released 7 November 2024), v1.40.2 (released 7 November 2024), v1.40.3 (released 7 November 2024), v1.40.4 (released 7 November 2024), v1.40.4a (released 8 November 2024) and v1.40.04b (released 11 November 2024). ==Removals== *Capture Button ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Trapper]] changed. **Traps are now swapped immediately after a new one is selected. **There is now a 10 second cooldown before traps can be changed again. **Traps now have lifespans, which are all set to 60 seconds. Lifespan resets when the trap hits an enemy. Lifespans are displayed above the traps. **Added trap descriptions when hovered over. *[[Hexscape Event]] extended to 20th of November 2024. *[[Boss]] now makes enemies immune to having their defense reduced. *Killing certain bosses now sends the player's friends a notification about the player's achievement. *Fixed poison and electric defense dropping not reducing defense of enemies. *{{Color|Premium|Green}} [[Paintballer]] skin Level 3-5 is now anchored, making it able to attack enemies again. *Fixed [[Health Regen]] healing enemies to full health when [[Time Scale]] is set to 0x. *Fixed upgrading [[Trapper]] while its trap is set to landmines giving it spike trap firerate. *Fixed {{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} [[Farm]] Level 2 animations. *Fixed [[Harvester]] projectile not appearing. :In '''v1.40.0a''': *Fixed {{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} [[Farm]] models. :In '''v1.40.1''': *Fixed data loss issues. :In '''v1.40.2''': *Fixed data loss issues. :In '''v1.40.3''': *Fixed data loss issues. :In '''v1.40.4''': *Fixed data loss issues. :In '''v1.40.4a''': *Enabled [[Battlepass Boost]] on all maps. :In '''v1.40.4b''': *Disabled [[Battlepass Boost]] on all maps. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight3Thumbnail.png HexscapeNight1Thumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} HexscapeRegularNight3Icon.png HexscapeNight3BoostIcon.png HexscapeNight1Icon.png {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} V1.39.0Render.png }} ==Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log.
